title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
Job Description – Desktop Support Engineer

**Experience:** Fresher  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location: Janak Puri , New Delhi**  
**Role:** Desktop Support Engineer / IT Support Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Desktop Support Engineer with fresher experience** to provide L1/L2 technical support to end users. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting desktop/laptop hardware, Windows OS, software, printers, networking, email, and other IT\-related issues. The role also involves ticket management, IT asset tracking, user onboarding, and remote/onsite support. These responsibilities align with current India\-based desktop support roles. IIndeed\+2

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **L1/L2 support** for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot **Windows 10/11** operating systems.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware issues involving RAM, HDD/SSD, motherboard, display, keyboard, mouse, etc.
* Troubleshoot **MS Office, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive**, and other business applications.
* Configure and troubleshoot **LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP** issues.
* Perform basic **Active Directory** tasks such as user creation, password resets, account unlocks, and permissions.
* Provide remote support using tools such as **Quick Assist, AnyDesk, TeamViewer**, or similar tools.
* Handle IT support tickets and ensure issues are resolved within defined **SLA/TAT**.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, and troubleshooting activities.
* Support **new\-joiner onboarding**, laptop allocation, software installation, and user setup.
* Maintain and update **IT asset inventory**.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and printer/network issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate L2/L3 or infrastructure teams.
* Follow company IT security policies and standard operating procedures.

Required Skills

* Fresher in **Desktop Support / IT Support / Helpdesk**.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of **Windows 10/11**.
* Strong hardware and software troubleshooting skills.
* Basic knowledge of **networking concepts – IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi\-Fi and VPN**.
* Working knowledge of **MS Office and Outlook**.
* Basic understanding of **Active Directory**.
* Experience with ticketing/helpdesk tools is preferred.
* Knowledge of remote support tools.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of an IT support team.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / Graduate / BCA / B.Sc. / B.Tech / BE in **Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field**.
* **CompTIA A\+, Network\+, ITIL Foundation, or similar certification** would be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

* Ticket resolution within agreed SLA.
* First\-call/first\-level resolution rate.
* User satisfaction.
* Accurate ticket and asset documentation.
* Timely onboarding/offboarding support.
* Reduction in recurring desktop and hardware issues.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹17,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
